description: 1969 is the Year of the Earth Rooster in the Chinese zodiac, from February 17, 1969 to February 5, 1970. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1969 is the Year of the Earth Rooster, a Yin year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 17, 1969 and ended on February 5, 1970, so people born in 1969 before Feb 17 belong to the Earth Monkey year.

sections.heading: When the 1969 Earth Rooster year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1969 Earth Rooster year began at Lunar New Year on February 17, 1969 and lasted until February 5, 1970, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Feb 17 1969 therefore belongs to the Earth Monkey year that started in 1968, while someone born in early 1970, up to Feb 5, is still a Earth Rooster. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Earth Rooster combination also falls in 2029, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1969 fell on a Monday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Earth Rooster personality
paragraphs: Methodical, responsible and deeply reliable, the Earth Rooster cares about doing things properly. Earth nourishes the Rooster's Metal, which tradition reads as diligence given stability and depth. People born in this year often make trusted managers and craftspeople. Resistance to new methods is the usual caution, so trying others' ideas now and then helps. Workshops, ledgers and well-run kitchens often bear their mark.

Earth sits at the centre of the five-element wheel, and an Earth year is traditionally said to give any animal steadiness, patience and a practical turn of mind. Descriptions associate it with reliability, honesty and a talent for holding things together, whether that means a family, a budget or a team in a difficult season. Earth-year people are often portrayed as grounded, fair and good at turning ideas into workable plans. The element is linked with nourishment and care, so it carries a quiet generosity. Its shadow, in most readings, is heaviness: worry, stubbornness and a reluctance to move until every risk has been weighed twice.

sections.heading: 1969 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the year reduces to 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner work, giving a 7 year a quieter, more searching character. The digits of 1969 add up to 25, which reduces to 7. In the twelve-year cycle the Rooster is the tenth animal, earthly branch You, with Metal as its fixed element and Yin polarity. The year element is Earth, and in the five-element cycles earth generates Metal. The year before was the Earth Monkey and the year after is the Metal Dog.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Ji-You: Ji is the Earth heavenly stem and You is the Rooster's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yin stems only ever meet yin animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1969?
faq.answer: 1969 is the Year of the Earth Rooster. It started on February 17, 1969 and ended on February 5, 1970.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1969?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 17. Born before February 17, 1969, you are a Earth Monkey; born on or after it, you are a Earth Rooster.

faq.question: What element is 1969 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Earth, a Yin year. The Rooster's own fixed element is Metal; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1969?
faq.answer: Ji-You. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Earth Rooster year?
faq.answer: 2029, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 2029.
